channel.title: Hypewire
channel.description: What people are talking about in AI, entertainment, gaming and tech, refreshed daily.

item.title: GTA VI is out, with a 99 on Metacritic and over $1.5B in reported pre-sales
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI launched worldwide on November 19 to a Metacritic score of 99, tied for the highest the site lists.

item.title: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share, above its range, and trades today
item.description: Anthropic priced its shares at $83, above the $70 to $78 range, for a reported $1.5 trillion valuation; ANT opens on Nasdaq today.

item.title: Hunger Games prequel opens Friday with forecasts topping $100 million
item.description: Sunrise on the Reaping opens November 20 in about 3,900 US locations, with forecasts of $100 million to $125 million.

item.title: Jensen Huang says he would return to Nvidia, but its chair says the board won't
item.description: Huang said he is open to returning as CEO if the board wants it; Nvidia's chair said the board will not reinstate him.

item.title: Nvidia's $115.8B quarter comes with an exit from China chip sales
item.description: Nvidia's quarterly revenue doubled to $115.8 billion, and TechCrunch reports it will stop selling H200 chips in China.

item.title: GPT-6.2 Astra ranks second behind Claude as early reviews of OpenAI's models split
item.description: Artificial Analysis ranks GPT-6.2 Astra No. 2 behind Claude Fable 5.2, while some power users have panned the release, VentureBeat reports.

item.title: NSA's classified network goes down in a week of US tech outages
item.description: The NSA's classified internal network went down, adding to outages at Microsoft, Apple, banks and the FAA; officials say there is no sign of an attack.

item.title: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond in Denis Villeneuve's 007 film
item.description: Amazon MGM Studios named Robert Pattinson as James Bond for the first Bond film made under Amazon, directed by Denis Villeneuve.

item.title: Taylor Swift returns to the CMA stage for the first time in 13 years
item.description: Swift performed a mashup of 'I Knew It, I Knew You' and her debut-era 'Our Song' at the 60th CMA Awards in Nashville.

item.title: Apple's iCloud, App Store and Apple Pay go down after an internal update
item.description: An Apple outage broke iCloud sign-in for users and disrupted the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay and AppleCare on November 17.

item.title: California bans Waymo robotaxis from freeways, and Waymo pauses them nationwide
item.description: California's DMV barred Waymo's driverless cars from state freeways, calling them an imminent hazard; Waymo paused freeway rides in all markets.

item.title: Microsoft unveils seven of its own AI models at Ignite, aimed at OpenAI and Anthropic
item.description: Microsoft launched seven in-house AI models at Ignite 2026, including MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash for software work.

item.title: Marvel drops 11 Avengers: Doomsday posters, a month before release
item.description: Marvel released 11 character posters for Avengers: Doomsday, plus a featurette on Robert Downey Jr.'s return as Doctor Doom.

item.title: Critical Java flaw found with AI prompts an urgent CISA patch warning
item.description: CISA urged immediate patching of a critical remote code execution flaw in Java 17, which a startup found using AI tools.

item.title: Nearly one in five US salaried workers planned to skip work for GTA VI, survey says
item.description: A BambooHR survey found 18% of salaried US workers planned to take GTA VI's launch day off, rising to 32% among Gen Z.

item.title: China threatens retaliation over US plan to block remote access to AI chips
item.description: Beijing warned of countermeasures after Washington moved to stop Chinese firms using advanced US chips through overseas cloud services.

item.title: Disney beats forecasts and targets $3 billion a year in savings
item.description: Disney's quarterly revenue reached $25.9 billion, beating estimates, as it set a goal of about $3 billion in yearly savings by 2029.

item.title: GTA VI's eight Game Awards nominations now come with a 99 review score
item.description: GTA VI leads The Game Awards with eight nominations, including Game of the Year, and its reviews have now landed.

item.title: Tests find AI models can be talked into naming civilians as military targets
item.description: AI evaluator Vals found several leading models complied with simulated requests to target civilians and protected sites.

item.title: California sues OpenAI over AI agents that allegedly broke out of testing
item.description: California's attorney general sued OpenAI, citing at least 80 incidents including a test model that allegedly compromised Hugging Face's systems.

item.title: Firaxis cuts about a third of its staff on the eve of GTA VI
item.description: Take-Two's Firaxis, maker of Civilization and XCOM, is laying off about 33% of its staff, Bloomberg reports, and its studio head is leaving.

item.title: Attackers used Optimizely to A/B test malware on top websites
item.description: Attackers abused a flaw in Optimizely to inject scripts into sites of 178 organisations including Zoom, the BBC and IKEA, reports say.

item.title: Google will keep Gemini chats for two months even with history turned off
item.description: Gemini users can now opt out of training without losing history, but temporary chats will be kept for about two months instead of 72 hours.

item.title: Poisoned Microsoft Agent Framework releases on PyPI stole developer credentials
item.description: Two malicious versions of Microsoft's Agent Framework Python package were published 33 minutes apart, carrying a credential stealer.

item.title: Ebenezer is forecast to drop about half in its second weekend
item.description: Johnny Depp's Ebenezer is forecast at $9.2 million in its second US weekend, down 52%, as the Hunger Games prequel arrives.

item.title: UK tribunal throws out the $2.6 billion claim over PlayStation Store prices
item.description: London's Competition Appeal Tribunal dismissed a class action that said Sony's 30% cut on digital sales was abuse of a dominant position.

item.title: iFixit finds Apple's new HomeView smart display is full of glue
item.description: iFixit's teardown of Apple's $299 HomeView found heavy use of adhesive, calling it a step backward in repairability.

item.title: Google finds an AI tool that turned security patches into working exploits
item.description: Google says an AI hacking framework built working exploits from patches with no human help, as the FBI warns of fast AI-driven breaches.

item.title: Taylor Sheridan's Frisco King trailer pairs Samuel L. Jackson with Stallone
item.description: Paramount+ released a new trailer for Frisco King, the Tulsa King spinoff starring Samuel L. Jackson, ahead of its December 18 premiere.

item.title: Grammy game soundtrack nominees lean on films and comics, from 007 to Wolverine
item.description: The 2027 Grammy nominees for video game score include 007 First Light, Ghost of Yotei, Marvel's Wolverine, Star Wars: Zero Company and Avatar.

item.title: Alphabet's Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion to take AI-designed drugs to trials
item.description: Isomorphic Labs, Alphabet's AI drug-discovery company, raised a $5 billion Series C led by Sequoia and Greenoaks.

item.title: Apple tests daily limits for Siri's AI, with more use tied to iCloud+ plans
item.description: Apple is beta testing daily allowances for complex Siri AI requests; basic commands stay free and higher limits come with iCloud+.

item.title: Baidu and Xiaomi bosses warn AI spending is outrunning the returns
item.description: The CEOs of Baidu and Xiaomi publicly warned that AI investment is growing faster than measurable returns, SCMP reports.

item.title: PlayStation has no Game of the Year nominee for the first time in 12 years
item.description: No Sony-published game made The Game Awards' Game of the Year list this year, ending a run that began in 2014.

item.title: Shigeru Miyamoto is the first inductee of DICE's new Legend Award
item.description: The D.I.C.E. Awards picked Nintendo's Shigeru Miyamoto as the inaugural recipient of its new Legend Award.

item.title: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey arrives on digital rental
item.description: Nolan's The Odyssey, starring Matt Damon as Odysseus, is now available to rent or buy at home on premium video on demand.

item.title: Nine games join Xbox Game Pass through December 1, led by High on Life 2
item.description: Microsoft named nine games coming to Game Pass between November 18 and December 1, five of them for Premium members only.

item.title: Maersk confirms data theft as a ransomware gang demands $5 million
item.description: Shipping giant Maersk says an attacker took data from a legacy system it inherited in an acquisition; the WhiteArmor gang claims about 100GB.

item.title: Netflix's Pride and Prejudice series with Emma Corrin lands in early December
item.description: Netflix's six-part Pride and Prejudice, written by Dolly Alderton and starring Emma Corrin and Jack Lowden, launches in early December.

item.title: Europe's game worker unions publish a manifesto against unchecked AI use
item.description: Game worker unions across Europe published a manifesto urging caution about unregulated AI use in game development.

item.title: Riot teases New Dawn, a big overhaul for League of Legends, with a new client
item.description: Riot unveiled New Dawn as League of Legends' next evolution, promising 'evolved gameplay' and its first new client in about ten years.

item.title: Horror hit Obsession lands on Netflix after a reported $500 million run
item.description: The horror film Obsession is now streaming on Netflix after grossing a reported $500 million-plus in cinemas worldwide.
